label_objective: Teacher KL averaged over 32 continuation predictions; same jointly selected route on prompt and continuation.

limitations: Line boundaries follow the archived corpus writer; original URLs and remote document IDs were not preserved.

Natural continuation is not a chat or downstream task benchmark.
